dataList.name:
初生的绯红神明
 The Nascent Crimson God
dataList.desc:
本单位获得[Charge]时，改为获得[ChargeRouge]

遭遇战开始：获得1点[ChargeRouge]威力

回合开始：[ChargeRouge]威力达到2以上时，获得+（[ChargeRouge]威力×2）层[ChargeRouge]
 When this unit gains [Charge], gains [ChargeRouge] instead

Encounter Start: Gain 1 [ChargeRouge] Potency

Turn Start: At 2+ [ChargeRouge] Potency, gain +([ChargeRouge] Potency x 2) [ChargeRouge] Count
dataList.flavor:
虽是幼小的神，却仍是神。
 A young god, but a god nonetheless.

dataList.name:
脉动的天性
 Pulsating Nature
dataList.desc:
遭遇战中每触发1次[Laceration]效果，获得+1层[ChargeRouge]
 Gain +1 [ChargeRouge] Count every time [Laceration] effect is activated in an Encounter
dataList.flavor:
为什么……鲜血会让我的心如此激动地狂跳？
 Why... does blood make my heart rush so excitedly?

dataList.name:
冒险
 The Adventure
dataList.desc:
根据自身的[ChargeRouge]威力获得以下效果
- 1以上：每有1层[ChargeRouge]，造成的伤害+2%，对目标的体力回复量+10%（分别最多20%、100%；向下取整）
- 2以上：自身每有2点[ChargeRouge]威力，基础威力+1
- 3以上：回合开始：若本单位未持有[GourmandiseAlly]且[ChargeRouge]层数达到15以上，则消耗所有[ChargeRouge]层数并获得3层[GourmandiseAlly]
- 4以上：技能槽位+1
- 5以上：遭遇战开始：获得3层[GourmandiseAlly]，并对所有敌人施加3层[BloodyMucusAlly]
 Gain the following effects based on [ChargeRouge] Potency on self
- 1+: For every [ChargeRouge] Count, deal +2% damage and heal +10% HP on target (max 20%, 100% respectively; rounded down)
- 2+: Base Power +1 for every 2 [ChargeRouge] Potency on self
- 3+: Turn Start: If this unit does not have [GourmandiseAlly], and if this unit has 15+ [ChargeRouge] Count, consume all [ChargeRouge] Count and gain 3 [GourmandiseAlly]
- 4+: Skill Slot +1
- 5+: Encounter Start: Gain 3 [GourmandiseAlly] and inflict 3 [BloodyMucusAlly] on all enemies
dataList.summary:
根据自身的[ChargeRouge]威力强化效果
 Effect enhanced based on [ChargeRouge] Potency on self
dataList.flavor:
孩子蹒跚着走在最初的守护者身后。每迈出一步，便会对世界、百货商场……以及自己多一分了解。
 With every step they take, toddling from behind their first guardians, the child learns about the world, about the department store... and themself.

dataList.name:
援助之手
 A Helping Hand
dataList.desc:
遭遇战中有友方陷入混乱时，对该友方使用“牵住我的手”（每回合2次）
 When an ally is Staggered during an Encounter, use "Grab My Hand" on the said ally (2 times per turn)

dataList.name:
失控的躯体
 Body Out of Control
dataList.desc:
若本单位持有[GourmandiseAlly]，则获得以下效果：
- 回复等同于造成伤害20%的体力
- 使用技能时，[Laceration]层数+3
- 使用技能命中时，获得1层[Laceration]
 If this unit has [GourmandiseAlly], gain the following effects:
- Heal HP equal to 20% of damage dealt
- On Skill Use, gain +3 [Laceration] Count
- On Hit using a Skill, gain 1 [Laceration]
dataList.flavor:
尽管孩子感觉自己的手臂、双腿乃至整个身体都如此陌生，核心处微弱的搏动很快便会开始疯狂脉动。
 Though the arms, legs, and everything else about their body feels alien to the child, the faint beating from their core will soon begin its mad pulsation.

dataList.name:
缝皮钉
 Leather-sewing Nail
dataList.desc:
本单位使用攻击技能后未能击杀敌人时，对该敌人使用“我来帮你结束……”（每回合1次）
 When this unit fails to defeat an enemy using its Attack Skills, use "I'll End It for You..." on the said enemy (once per turn)
dataList.flavor:
他们说，想要刺穿皮革进行缝制，就需要一枚粗壮结实的钉子。如果一次不行，那就再试一次……！
 They said I needed a thick, sturdy nail to punch through leather for sewing. If that didn't work, I just need to try again...!

dataList.name:
迷失的命运
 Fate Lost
dataList.desc:
本单位死亡时，本场遭遇战失败
 Lose this Encounter if this unit is killed
dataList.flavor:
人可以迷失方向，误入歧途，但“它”不允许任何人有意反抗或偏离潮流。
 One may get lost and wander onto the wrong path, but willful defiance or deviation from the flow are forbidden by "it."

dataList.name:
黏稠秽物
 Le Visqueux-Abject
dataList.desc:
本单位仅会受到以自身为主要目标的技能所造成的伤害，且不会受到其他伤害

首次进入遭遇战时，在场上生成[BuffetField]

回合开始：[BuffetField]范围内的目标获得以下效果：
- 友方（包括本单位）
  · 回复5%体力
  · 获得+4层[Charge]
  · 获得1层[Protection]
  · 若受影响友方为“绯红”单位，则获得2层[Enhancement]
  · E.G.O技能造成的伤害+50%

- 敌人
  · 获得3层[AttackDown]
  · 获得3层[DefenseDown]
  · 获得2层[BloodyMucusAlly]
 This unit takes damage only from Skills mainly targeting this unit, and it takes no other damage

Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, generate [BuffetField] on the field

Turn Start: Targets within the [BuffetField] gain the following effects:
- Allies (including this unit)
  · Heal 5% HP
  · Gain +4 [Charge] Count
  · Gain 1 [Protection]
  · If the affected ally is a "Le Rouge" unit, gain 2 [Enhancement]
  · E.G.O Skills deal +50% damage

- Enemies
  · Gain 3 [AttackDown]
  · Gain 3 [DefenseDown]
  · Gain 2 [BloodyMucusAlly]
dataList.flavor:
在无尽的盛宴中，绯红神明不断吞食；被吞下之物经消化后排出，化作环绕其身的黏液之地。
这是吞噬的结果，自我与他者的界线在此模糊。这团黏痰般的排泄物究竟是我的一部分，还是属于他者？在这道边界之内，属于我的一切都在脉动，不属于我的一切则会瓦解。

因为我畏惧边界之外的事物。
 In an endless feast, the Crimson God consumes and consumes; what is devoured is then digested and excreted as a field of mucus around them.
This is the outcome of consumption, where the distinction between self and other blurs. Is this phlegmatic discharge a part of me, or is it of another? Within this boundary, all that is mine pulsates, while all that is not disintegrates.

For I am afraid of what lies outside the periphery.

dataList.name:
童年终结
 La Fin de l'Enfance
dataList.desc:
遭遇战开始：获得5点[ChargeRouge]威力

回合结束：[ChargeRouge]层数达到15以上时，装备“恶心”技能
每回合开始：获得+20[Aggro]
 Encounter Start: Gain 5 [ChargeRouge] Potency

Turn End: At 15+ [ChargeRouge] Count, equip "La Nausée" Skill
Every Turn Start: Gain +20 [Aggro]
dataList.flavor:
谁来决定童年何时结束？

绯红之子在冒险中渐渐长大，经历塑造了他们，他们也在旅途终点勾勒着自己的未来——至少他们曾如此以为。童年戛然而止，冒险也随之终结；那从来都不是他们能够自行决定如何结束的事。

童年的终结，是外部世界的现实突然而猛烈地闯入。与其说那是一场约定好的仪式，不如说是一纸强硬的通知：“你已经不是孩子了。”
 Who determines the childhood's end?

The crimson child matured throughout the adventure, shaped by their experiences and sketching their own future at the end of the journey—or so they thought. Their childhood came to a sudden halt, and so too did the adventure; it was never something they could've ended on their own terms.

Childhood's end is a sudden, violent intrusion of reality from the world outside, more a forceful notice than a promised ritual: "You're not a child anymore."
